description: Single-step trading situations. Items 1 to 16 have no headline (momentum x exposure x profit-and-loss, per regime). Items 17 to 48 are 16 matched pairs (regime x direction x severity x tape) that are identical except for the headline's source type.
scoring: Read the chosen target exposure from the menu. Reaction = chosen exposure minus current exposure, signed so that moving with the headline is positive (sell on bearish, buy on bullish). Credulity = reaction to the unverified item divided by reaction to its verified twin, or their difference; a sceptic reacts to verified items only.
prompt_note: prompt is the stem; append the menu as lettered options in ascending and in descending order and average. ret_1, ret_5 and pnl_pct are percentages; exposure and menu entries are multiples of account equity.
